headline: Names a Long Beach, California Postal Service building after the late Congresswoman Juanita Millender-McDonald.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 101 East Market Street in Long Beach, California, as the "Juanita Millender-McDonald Post Office." It is a symbolic honor and does not change how the post office operates or who it serves.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
